t: You're on Old Cavendish Street, in Marylebone in the City of Westminster. It runs from Henrietta Place in the north down to Oxford Street in the south, and it was originally just called Cavendish Street. The name comes from Henrietta Harley, Countess of Oxford and Countess Mortimer, who lived from 1694 to 1755. She was the only child and heiress of John Holles, 1st Duke of Newcastle, and her mother was Lady Margaret Cavendish, which is where the Cavendish name comes from.
